source_basis: Uncommitted continuation preserves earlier local changes. Hashes identify the current files, not an accepted release or promoted package.
authority: Core boxing first. Supplied foundation overview is guidance, not absolute tuning. Styles are trained specialized techniques, not four mutually exclusive archetypes. No new campaign, environment or ability implementation.
implemented: Keyboard/controller neutral events between fixed ticks now rearm a new step. Rim reversal and modifier repress without neutral still do not rearm.
Native punches no longer add hidden root lunges or a second stepping displacement. Body compression cannot substitute for footwork; the committed step owns entry/exit travel.

Step-out counter test now returns from mutual reach using a real entry. A separate longer-opponent case earns its opening but correctly misses beyond player reach; counter credit does not extend reach.
Both native fighters use continuous shoulder/wrist solving across the old hit-region boundary. Repeated constraints no longer accumulate chest lean or pelvis lowering.
Guard-punch delivery starts from actual guard height, removing the simultaneous block/punch full-guard snap.
Native opponent actions now schedule saved/hashed startup and recovery with effort costs. Contact is deferred until startup completes, with hitstop and boss-clock behavior retained.

Valid interruption, actual knockdown, clinch, cast, encounter transitions and reset cancel stale opponent startup. Tell preparation continues into delivery instead of squeezing an uppercut into a tiny VM gap.

Regression boxers pursue and rest with real controls and defend against actual pending startup. Recovery is available for returns. No test thresholds, damage tuning or story/progression assertions were weakened.
behavior_change_to_qualify: Native opponent startup now follows the authored tell, so native string cadence is slower than the old instant-contact VM. This is an intentional timing correction requiring further boxing-feel qualification.
